name: Tokushu Houshi Iin no Jimiko-san
original_name: 特殊奉仕委員の地味子さん
source:
In 201X, in response to the increase in crime and young people's indifference to sexuality,
The government experimentally established a special service committee at a certain school in a certain region.
Those appointed as special service members shall faithfully follow the instructions.
Healing the mentally ill through sex.
And when special service members are asked to perform sexual acts, they must comply with the request.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ155640.html/]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
201X年，针对犯罪率上升和年轻人对性的漠视，
政府在某个地区的某所学校试行设立了专门服务委员会。
被任命为特勤人员的，应当忠实执行指挥。
通过性来治愈精神疾病。
当特种部队成员被要求进行性行为时，他们必须遵守要求。
